_note: Extra details the RSS feed doesn't carry, keyed by each episode's guid from the feed. category is one of: business, law, risk, other. youtubeId is the part after watch?v= in the episode's YouTube link; it sets the Watch link and the thumbnail. Episodes not listed here still appear, just without a category or YouTube link. byNumber holds the same details keyed by episode number, for an episode that isn't in the feed yet (no guid). Page extras: slug (URL), hosts, showNotes (paragraphs), chapters ([{time: 'mm:ss', title}]), transcript (file name in data/transcripts/ without .json).
